subject.title: [OAuth] Client ID revoked `app_EMoamEEZ73f0CkXaXp7hrann` - fresh ChatGPT Plus logins completely broken

question: Should OpenClaw rotate the built-in OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex OAuth client ID, keep the current upstream-aligned ID, or add a temporary override path while upstream ownership is clarified?
rationale: OAuth app registration and client ownership are outside a safe autonomous code edit, and current evidence suggests browser OAuth and device-code behavior may not fail the same way.

options.title: Coordinate official rotation
options.body: Register or obtain an approved replacement client and update browser, device-code, refresh, tests, docs, and upstream Codex compatibility together.

options.title: Hold for live proof
options.body: Keep the issue open with the current client ID until a maintainer or reporter provides fresh-browser proof that the upstream client is actually revoked.

options.title: Add temporary override
options.body: Introduce a documented maintainer/operator override only if official rotation cannot happen quickly and the upgrade/support tradeoff is accepted.

recommendation.title: Coordinate official rotation
recommendation.body: Register or obtain an approved replacement client and update browser, device-code, refresh, tests, docs, and upstream Codex compatibility together.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried the current OpenAI provider identity and OAuth file split in the merged feature history.
